name: Modal Layout Regressions (grid gaps, phantom classes, leaderboard placement)

mutations.name: a modal action button gets a utility class this app never defines
mutations.why: mb-2 and mt-2 are Bootstrap names. Nothing in this stylesheet defines them, so the class does nothing and the buttons sit flush against each other. On the game-over modal a mis-hit is the difference between watching an ad and losing the run. The first attempt at this mutation wrote the class with escaped quotes, so the file held className=\" and the gate — which looks for a plain quote — correctly did not match. That was a bad mutation, not a bad gate.
mutations.replace:
const __phantom = '<button className="btn btn-secondary w-100 mb-2">';
export function VictoryModal

mutations.name: a stat grid loses its gap while other rules in the file keep theirs
mutations.why: External audit V11. Test 1 asked whether the FILE contained gap: 8px, so with the grid's gap deleted, a gap on any other rule in modals.css answered for it and the gate passed. It now reads the grid rule itself.
